Meta Platforms saw its shares surge by 11.43% to close at $741.25. The stock reached an intraday high of $753 and a low of $679.60, with a 52-week range of $520.26 to $785.73.

Greenland Mines shares skyrocketed by 230.53% to close at $9.42, hitting an intraday high of $11.68 and a low of $6.63. The stock’s 52-week range is $2.82 to $27.48. In the after-hours session, the stock rose 16.03% to $10.93.

The surge followed the company’s expansion of its Sarfartoq rare earth magnet district land position in West Greenland. The expansion adds 262 square kilometers, bringing the total to approximately 454 square kilometers. The expansion comes after President
announced a U.S.-Denmark Greenland Security Agreement that reinforces the territory’s strategic importance.

Intel Corp. rose by 12.14% to close at $121.78, with an intraday high of $124.73 and a low of $114.93. The stock’s 52-week range is $28.73 to $142.34. In extended trading, the stock rose 1.7% to $123.85.

Intel shares rose, extending a rally that had lifted the stock roughly 278% over the past year, while the company benefited from broader strength in technology and semiconductor stocks. Recent catalysts included Altera’s confidential U.S. IPO filing and reports that
was considering producing memory chips at Intel facilities, while Intel’s Momentum score stood at 98.93 and its Hold consensus carried an average price target of $112.74.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc. climbed 9.95% to close at $615.52, reaching an intraday high of $616.69 and a low of $582.27. The stock’s 52-week range is $154.78 to $616.69.

AMD shares hit a record high after gaining 8.4% to $606.98, extending their 2026 rally to about 183%, following major AI infrastructure commitments. The company crossed the $1 trillion market cap mark on Monday.

OpenAI agreed to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, while Oracle committed to 50,000 MI450 accelerators; AMD said the OpenAI deal was immediately accretive and could support tens of billions of dollars in annual AI data center revenue from 2027.

GameStop Corp. shares edged up by 0.53% to close at $22.76, with an intraday high of $23.11 and a low of $22.52. The stock’s 52-week range is $17.79 to $28.10. In the after-hours session, the stock rose 3.21% to $23.49.
